title: export foreground service
description:
Owner finding 2026-11-14: a backgrounded 1749-frame export died
silently — Android's OomAdjuster moved the app to the cached state and
froze the process mid-render ("freezing 25368 com.ritim.ritimcraw").

While a job is RUNNING the process now holds foreground priority
through a dataSync foreground service, so the OomAdjuster can never
cache-and-freeze it again. The service is deliberately thin: every
start/progress/stop decision lives in the JVM-tested
ExportForegroundController, the notification building is pure, and the
framework edge (ExportNotificationSink) is best-effort throughout — a
system refusal degrades to exactly the pre-service behavior and never
crashes the export.

Wiring, one seam for BOTH exporters, ridden by ExportQueue's own state
transitions:
- start rides the successful pick-to-RUNNING flip (a job cancelled
  before the start never gains the priority), with the job'
changed: feat: export foreground service holds priority
